description: This Java class 'Wizard' provides a UI component with a trigger wizard process, including steps to send commands, handle user interactions, and monitor RPM sensor state for a hardware trigger setup.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: A UI component managing a step-by-step trigger configuration process with command dispatching and RPM monitoring.

classes.name: Wizard.WizardStep
classes.description: Interface for a wizard step providing a component content.

classes.name: Wizard.WizardStepImpl
classes.description: Abstract implementation of WizardStep, supporting chaining to next steps.

classes.name: Wizard.SendCommand
classes.description: A wizard step that sends a specified command and proceeds to the next step upon confirmation.

classes.name: Wizard.TRIGGER_WIZARD_HELLO
classes.description: Initial wizard step with a button to start the trigger wizard sequence.

classes.name: Wizard.WaitForZeroRpm
classes.description: Wizard step that waits until the RPM sensor reads zero before proceeding.

methods.name: createPane
methods.description: Creates and returns the main UI panel with trigger button and other components.

methods.name: applyStep
methods.description: Transitions the wizard to a new step, updating the UI content.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Obtains the UI component for a given wizard step.

methods.name: scheduleRepaint
methods.description: Sets up a timer to refresh the UI after a delay, executing a specific wizard step.
